name: Garden Star-of-Bethlehem
desc: Garden Star-of-Bethlehem (Ornithogalum umbellatum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ornithogalum umbellatum, the garden star-of-Bethlehem, grass lily, nap-at-noon, or eleven-o'clock lady, is a perennial bulbous flowering plant in the asparagus family (Asparagaceae). O.
